name: Qiu Ye
source:
The campus story of the school season. Autumn leaves are the second short stories of Muzi's workshop, telling beautiful campus love stories.

What is the most important thing in college life? Love? Friendship? Or the surging youth?

In the autumn leaves, you will experience the different campus life with the leading characters.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/939750/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
這是校園季的故事。《秋葉》是木子工坊的第二部短篇作品，講述美麗的校園戀愛故事。

大學生活中最重要的是什麼？愛情？友情？還是澎湃的青春？

在《秋葉》中，你將與主角們一起體驗不一樣的校園生活。

[來源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/939750/]Steam[/url]]
